# Project context (static — do not edit mid-session)

## Layout
- scale/  — the reusable product (jobhunt-agent budget/ledger/dashboard code).
- scripts/ — named one-off pipeline scripts (build, pack, fetch, ledger, probes).
- data/    — generated output: scrapes, cards, rows, raw dumps. Ignore unless told.
- scratch/ — throwaway _* experiment history. Ignore unless told.
- docs/    — AGENT_ROUTING.md, EXPERIMENT.md.

## Commands
- Syntax check: python3 -m py_compile scale/*.py scale/artifacts/*/*.py
- Full suite: cd scale && python3 -m unittest discover -s artifacts
  NOTE: the suite imports dashboard/, engine/, tools/, billing/ — the jobhunt-agent
  source that lived on the retired VM. It is NOT in this snapshot; recover it before
  trusting a green run. Until then py_compile is the only verification.
- No build step, no package manager, no linter configured.

## Architecture
The reusable product lives under scale/; everything else is job-hunt scratch.
- dashboard/server.py serves /api/usage, /api/alerts and the tenant dials.
- engine/gates/model_budget.py enforces the per-tenant spend budget.
- provisioning.carry_budget_dial writes the dial into a provisioned workspace.
- tools/price_model.py prices tokens; tools/cost_report.py is the operator view.
- Ledger is data/usage.jsonl (one JSON line per run).

## Conventions
- Tests use stdlib unittest, not pytest. Assert real results, never plausible ones.
- A budget dial must degrade to defaults and never crash or slow a run.
- One number everywhere: the ledger the gate enforces is the ledger the UI shows.

## Off-limits
- Never send email (read-only). Never auto-submit a job application.
- Never touch credentials, .env, or production config.
- Do not edit this file or switch models mid-session (breaks prefix cache).
